metadata.description: JITX hardware design automation skills for PCB design, component modeling, substrate modeling, circuit creation, physical layout authoring, layout constraints and design rules, signal integrity constraints, pin assignment flexibility, same-model JITX code review, mechanical CAD interchange, and the opt-in JLCPCB fab option

plugins.name: jitx-skills
plugins.description: JITX workflow skills for PCB design. Use jitx-project-builder to turn board requirements into a complete, verified design through phased sub-agent work. Use jitx-component-modeler for component creation from datasheets. Use jitx-circuit-builder for wiring circuits, passives, and application circuits. Use jitx-substrate-modeler for capturing information about the fabrication substrate. Use jitx-code-layout to write a fixed layout in code: placement, code-placed vias, code routes and narrowing, length matching, pours, keepouts, copper and overlappable copper (antennas, filters, net ties), and reading the realized layout back. Use jitx-layout-constraints for design rules, clearances, classes of nets by tag, power trace width, pour rules, via stitching and fencing, routing structures applied by tag, and fanout step-down into package pads. Use jitx-interconnect-constraints for signal integrity constraints (timing, skew, insertion loss), pin models, differential pairs, daisy-chain topology, and protocol-level constraint patterns. Use jitx-pin-assignment for pin assignment patterns including provide/require, pin muxing, DiffPair P/N swapping, PCIe lane ordering, DDR byte/bit swapping, and SI constraints on pin-assigned ports. Use jitx-code-review for same-model self-critique of JITX Python code against the anti-string-hacking architectural rules — mandatory for complete-board tier at task acceptance, user-invoked for single-task work. Use jitx-mechanical for mechanical CAD import/export through the jitx-mechanical CLI, Model3D STEP attachment, and board STEP export guidance. Use jitx-jlcpcb, the opt-in JLCPCB fab option, only once the user has chosen JLCPCB: its predefined substrates, LCSC parts and assembly tiers, catalogue footprints, and the order packet.
